releases.headline: More reliable phone-to-PC control
releases.summary: More reliable phone-to-PC control · Bluetooth and volume corrections
releases.brief: Keep controlling the PC after leaving the remote screen. Only show current nearby Bluetooth PCs. Keep the PC awake when a phone is controlling it.

highlights.title: Keep controlling the PC after leaving the remote screen
highlights.text: While a phone is connected, Android can keep its authenticated remote session running through a connected-device foreground service when Starlit is minimized or the user navigates elsewhere.

highlights.title: Only show current nearby Bluetooth PCs
highlights.text: Android expires stale scan results instead of offering devices that were nearby earlier.

highlights.title: Keep the PC awake when a phone is controlling it
highlights.text: Windows prevents automatic system sleep only during an authenticated remote session and returns to normal power management afterwards.

releases.headline: Phone-to-PC playback and pairing
releases.summary: Phone-to-PC playback and pairing · MyAnimeList and anime playback · Languages and security
releases.brief: Start a movie or episode from the phone. Manage MyAnimeList directly on desktop. More languages.

highlights.title: Start a movie or episode from the phone
highlights.text: Once a phone is securely paired with a compatible Starlit PC, choose a film, series or episode without accepting an extra playback prompt on the computer.

highlights.title: Manage MyAnimeList directly on desktop
highlights.text: A redesigned, responsive list provides status groups, sorting, richer details and inline editing of watch status, score, watched episodes and rewatching.

highlights.title: More languages
highlights.text: Add 13 additional interface translations for supported locales, excluding Hindi.

releases.headline: Privacy and diagnostics
releases.summary: Privacy and diagnostics · Phone remote and playback · Desktop performance and reliability
releases.brief: Find privacy controls easily. Show the actual connected PC. Lower overhead for ordinary streams.

highlights.title: Find privacy controls easily
highlights.text: Mobile Settings now includes a Privacy & Diagnostics shortcut to the existing Usage statistics switch.

highlights.title: Show the actual connected PC
highlights.text: The phone controller displays a verified active computer as Connected, offers Disconnect instead of a second Connect action, and avoids duplicate reconnections or queuing commands while disconnected.

highlights.title: Lower overhead for ordinary streams
highlights.text: Regular desktop streams use smaller forward/backward byte caches without reducing the existing P2P cache budgets or changing the established cache time horizon.

releases.headline: Intro skipping for movies and TV series
releases.summary: Intro skipping for movies and TV series · Phone-to-PC remote controls · Safer Android download cleanup
releases.brief: Skip openings beyond anime. No duplicate actions. Delete only files owned by the active profile.

highlights.title: Skip openings beyond anime
highlights.text: The player can use available intro and recap markers for films and regular TV episodes, not only anime.

highlights.title: No duplicate actions
highlights.text: The phone controller offers the existing Next episode transport button and a single contextual skip action, with the existing fullscreen-on-PC control.

highlights.title: Delete only files owned by the active profile
highlights.text: Android checks that a completed download belongs to the active profile, was created by the transfer scheduler, and has a matching stored file URI before deleting it.

releases.headline: Account creation and email verification
releases.summary: Account creation and email verification · Phone remote playback actions · Authentication security
releases.brief: Create an account without administrator approval. Control fullscreen from your phone. Keep passwords out of Android saved state.

highlights.title: Create an account without administrator approval
highlights.text: New Starlit users can register with email and a password of at least 12 characters.

highlights.title: Control fullscreen from your phone
highlights.text: The remote can request fullscreen on the connected Starlit PC instead of only changing its phone interface.

highlights.title: Keep passwords out of Android saved state
highlights.text: Password input is stored only in transient Compose memory and is not written into saved-instance-state bundles.
